name: Xposed Fake Location
tagline: Set a fake GPS location for your whole phone or one app
description:
Xposed Fake Location lets you set a custom GPS location on your Android phone, either everywhere or just inside specific apps. Unlike the built-in mock location developer option, it works through the Xposed framework, so apps that try to detect fake GPS have a harder time noticing.

It's popular for testing location-based apps, protecting your privacy from apps that don't need to know exactly where you are, or exploring location-based games and services. You'll need a rooted phone with Xposed or LSPosed installed to use it.
